answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake and build a record of independently verified jobs before gaining weight in high-value decisions. New identities start with little influence; repeated, consistent work earns reputation, while detected collusion can forfeit stakes. A sybil attacker must therefore lock up capital and maintain believable accounts over time, instead of minting identities for free. Even a nebula of opal profiles arranged in a spiral adds little influence without earned history.
